name: lofi
description: KOZMOS Lofi: generative lo-fi music while Claude works. Four original synthesized loops (focus, deep, night, sunny: warm chord pads, an electric piano, soft kick and hats with swing, vinyl crackle) loop from the start of a turn until it ends, and stop when Claude is idle. Opt-in: /lofi on. A tiny band shows '♪ lofi · deep' with a dancing equalizer while it plays.

enabled.title: Play music
enabled.description: Play lo-fi loops while Claude works. Off by default; /lofi on and /lofi off switch it too (remembered).

mood.title: Mood
mood.description: Which loop plays. auto picks by the local hour: sunny in the morning, focus in the afternoon, deep in the evening, night after 22:00.
